measurement_basis: verified source change, focused regression suite, and same-checkpoint live readback

outcome.implementation_scope: Compact campaign evidence path selection in the MNCS Environment capability-intelligence projection.
outcome.implementation_change: The byte-budget path now requires a matching verified occurrence, pressure hypothesis, and improvement relation. It retains the occurrence record when later supporting-context evidence shares its hypothesis identity.
outcome.verified_change: The capability-intelligence suite passes 163 tests. At the same persisted 85-record checkpoint, the 8 KiB live projection changed from retaining a supporting-context observation at 7,835 bytes to retaining the exact pressure occurrence at 7,797 bytes. Fifteen source pointers were integrity-verified, zero were unverified, and the linked verification and subsequent records were present.
outcome.interpretation_limit: This establishes that the compact projection now preserves the evidence role and provenance for the selected request. It does not establish agent receipt, reduced intervention burden, long-term recurrence, or that the pressure is eliminated.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Campaign growth can erase linked ECI evidence under a tight response budget
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Retain the exact occurrence that establishes a pressure when compacting its linked improvement path, even when later supporting-context observations share the hypothesis identity.
